verdict.rationale: GitBook's 'Change requests' feature (gitbook-docs-29) provides a git-like PR workflow for docs with review, comments, approvals, and merge before publishing, and GitBook Agent can review change requests (gitbook-docs-18). missing for 10: independent/hands-on community corroboration specifically of the review-approve-merge workflow (community evidence pack only covers older GitBook versions and unrelated issues).
